limits: five measured L per dataset: 200/400/800/1000/1200; no intermediate-L performance implied
10000 already exposed public queries per dataset, one public_test role; no independent confirmation role
descriptive bootstrap across 200 comparisons, no semantic IID or simultaneous comparison guarantee
256 count audit only; full 10000 saved plain/replay and region trace, no timed packet retention
NSG fixed entry has no GT route or post split; graph counts are compared to GT only for GT/M5/M5REG96
original/derived query and original GT source SHA reuse preflight full SHA plus exact current stat; not rehashed in evaluation
U-outside and rescue counts are per-query incidences, not global distinct IDs; new candidates are not evidence of unique cross-modal generalization
no new TRAIN, frozen original M5 supervision/models and raw-IP metric; this sweep does not replace GT10 by default
